segments.title: Cold Open & Technical Difficulties
segments.notes: Case and Fiona open the Cream Team Dream Stream; Kasim absent due to depression; audio issues plague the intro; they apologize to audio-only listeners for visual-heavy episode.

segments.title: Daily Star: Pleasure Boys XXL Male Strip Show
segments.notes: Discussion of Daily Star article about fully nude male strippers in Belfast; debate over whether show is for women or gay men; article describes audience members receiving ejaculate in hair; hosts question journalistic standards.

segments.title: Viral Video Hunt: Sexual Eating Tour Bus
segments.notes: Fiona describes a Miami-based tour bus where men feed women food sexually (bananas, strawberries); extensive failed search attempts on Twitter; Case calls Kevin Parada during hunt.

segments.title: Fred Durst Fallout: New Vegas Mod
segments.notes: Brief coverage of Destructoid article about a Fallout: New Vegas mod adding Fred Durst who plays Limp Bizkit songs when interacted with.

segments.title: Tinder & Hinge Lawsuit: Addictive Design
segments.notes: Federal lawsuit alleges Match Group gamifies dating apps to create addicts; discussion of Hinge's 'rose' paywall trapping attractive users; Case shares negative Tinder experience; both agree apps commodify genuine connection.

segments.title: Streamer Awards 2024 Recap & Critique
segments.notes: Review of Streamer Awards categories and winners (Kai Cenat, Jynxzi, Valkyrae, etc.); criticism of gay representation (Fortnite parody song controversy); debate over award show legitimacy and platform toxicity.

segments.title: Streamer Awards Aftermath & Industry Commentary
segments.notes: Discussion of Dan Clancy presenting to YouTube-exclusive Valkyrae; hypothetical Ben Shapiro appearance; critique of streaming culture elevating controversial figures; decision to end podcast.

segments.title: Found: Sexual Eating Tour Bus Video
segments.notes: Fiona locates the viral video; hosts watch explicit clip of women being fed food on a tour bus; Fiona vindicated after hour-long search.

segments.title: Sub Shoutout Rap & Raid
segments.notes: Case performs improvised smooth jazz rap thanking subscribers and bit donors; includes references to Hype Train level 3; raid initiated at close.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor / co-host. Co-hosts Cream Team Dream Stream with Fiona Nova; runs sub shoutout rap; mentions lighter schedule ahead.
lore_notes: [01:08:42] Case says he has been less busy and may return to streaming tomorrow.

characters.name: Kasim
characters.notes: absent co-host. Referenced as absent due to depression ('tower moment'); hosts send well wishes.
lore_notes: [03:13] Kasim described as going through a 'tower moment' and depressed.

lore_notes.fact: Kasim (Cream Team co-host) is absent due to depression, described as a 'tower moment'.
Case Blackwell indicates he has been less busy and may resume streaming tomorrow.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell and Fiona Nova host a casual Cream Team Dream Stream in Kasim's absence, covering a Daily Star article on nude male strippers, a federal lawsuit against Tinder and Hinge for addictive design, the 2024 Streamer Awards, and an hour-long search for a viral 'sexual eating tour bus' video which they eventually locate and watch. The episode closes with Case's improvised subscriber rap and a raid.
